subject: Corner activation + tactile collateral runbook — final decisions needed
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudcon.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.inference, marissa_cole@redwood.inference
Date: 2029-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Corner activation + tactile collateral runbook — initial ask

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the site map — we confirmed a corner island in Hall B. Before we lock the footprint, two quick asks so we can finalize the collateral manifest and AV plan: 

- Can you confirm exact sightline restrictions for 10'x10' vs 12'x12' corner footprints (any canopy or hanging restrictions)?
- Loading window for corner islands (we need the earliest crate access time for our demo crates).
- Is power pushed to the immediate back-left corner of the island or centralized? We may need a 20A dedicated run.

I'll attach our latest plan (corner_booth_plan_v2.pdf) with a suggested furniture layout and a small tactile demo table. If possible please confirm by EOD Friday so we can get the print vendor started.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: corner_booth_plan_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudcon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: operations@cloudcon.com
Date: 2029-07-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Corner activation + tactile collateral runbook — initial ask

Hi Marcus,

Quick answers below: 

- Sightlines: for corner islands the 12'x12' footprint is allowed but any overhead hanging signage is limited to 10' tall due to sprinkler clearances. You can have a 40in freestanding backstop but no overhead truss.
- Loading: corner islands are on Loading Window 2 — crates can be delivered starting 06:00 on move-in day, but the show floor team requests no heavy installs before 08:30 for safety.
- Power: power is dropped to the center-right of the grid; I can request a 20A feed to the back-left but that will be an additional charge from the venue.

I'll mark the corner_booth_plan_v2.pdf as received and loop in venue ops if you want me to submit a power change request.

Best,
Maya Singh
Exhibitor Services Manager
CloudCon Events

---
Forwarded attachment: conference_floor_rules.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole@redwood.inference
Date: 2029-07-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Corner activation + tactile collateral runbook — internal notes

Thanks — read through Maya's notes. A few operational decisions we should make this week: 

- Keep footprint at 12'x12' for extra demo space, but drop any overhead signage plans. We'll rely on floor decals + 3-sided backstop.
- Approve the 20A feed request if the venue cost is under $525 — it's worth it for the demo load.
- Collateral: tactile demo requires 100 handout kits and 60 small takeaways (branded sleeves). I'll draft the manifest and send to PrintRight.

Marc, can you confirm final counts so I can lock print quotes today? Marissa — can you confirm crate staffing (2 onsite leads + 1 spare) and AV sound check window?

-Lauren
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: collateral_manifest_v3.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

From: Atlas Exhibits <sales@atlasexhibits.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, lauren_bishop@redwood.inference
Cc: production@atlasexhibits.com
Date: 2029-07-16T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Quote: island rigging & backstop build — Atlas Exhibits (Q-4821)

Hi Marcus / Lauren,

Thanks for the booth plan. Per your 12'x12' layout we can do the 3-sided fabric backstop and a tactile demo pedestals run. Estimate below (line items):

- 12'x12' modular frame + fabric 3-sided backstop: $2,450
- Custom demo pedestal (x2): $540
- Onsite install & teardown crew: $980
- Power re-routing request handling (venue liaison fee): $150
- Freight handling (round-trip): $420

Subtotal: $4,540
Estimated lead time: needs signed PO by 2029-07-20 for guaranteed delivery.

Quote attached: atlas_quote_7-22.pdf

Please advise if we should proceed with PO for Q-4821.

Regards,
Ana Rios
Account Executive\Atlas Exhibits
sales@atlasexhibits.com
(555) 222-0174

Attachment: atlas_quote_7-22.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Atlas Exhibits <sales@atlasexhibits.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudcon.com>
Date: 2029-07-17T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quote: island rigging & backstop build — Atlas Exhibits (approval)

Thanks everyone — decision: approve the 12'x12' layout and Atlas quote (Q-4821). 

Action items: 
- Marcus: submit PO to Atlas (PO to be uploaded to vendor portal), target 2029-07-18 COB.
- Lauren: place PrintRight order for 100 handout kits + 60 branded sleeves (use manifest_v3).
- Marissa: confirm crate leads and book 08:30 install window with venue ops.
- Maya: please submit the 20A feed change request (we'll cover the charge).

I'll attach a short approval note for procurement.

Thanks — moving to execution.
Marcus
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval_note_PO.txt (TXT, 1KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2029-07-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Corner activation — crate leads & AC update

Confirmed: crate staffing locked (2 leads: Jenna P., Omar L.; spare: Raj S.). I booked the 08:30 install crew and added the AV sound check for 09:15. PrintRight acknowledged receipt of manifest and will send proofs by 2029-07-19.

I'll ping production the morning of move-in with the crate manifest and contact list.

-Marissa
Events Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

P.S. Atlas asked for the signed PO — Marcus, I'll add the vendor contact to the procurement ticket once you upload the PO.
